headline: Approved Standards of Conduct, Public Internet Use, Security, and revised Meeting Room policies, each by 7-0 vote.
summary: The board reviewed the Director's report covering the FY2026 and FY2027 budgets, building repairs, reduced hours at the Farms branch, and summer programs. It also voted to adopt four library policies without changes other than a correction to the Meeting Room Policy.
decisions: Approved the Standards of Conduct Policy, 7-0.
Approved the Public Internet Use Policy, 7-0.
Approved the revised Meeting Room Policy, 7-0.
